resources.string: Keeps your Shizuku service alive after every unlock. Works with original Shizuku, Shizuku Next, Shizuku+ and other forks.
Switch between dark and light mode

1. Install your Shizuku app: original Shizuku, Shizuku Next, Shizuku+ or any Shizuku-compatible fork.

2. Leave "Auto restart after unlock" switched on. The helper asks your Shizuku app to start after every unlock and keeps retrying until the Shizuku service is actually running.

3. If your fork needs a token for its START intent, paste it in the Auth token card and tap "Save token".

4. Tap "Disable Battery Restrictions" and allow it, so the system does not kill the helper. The button disappears once the restriction is gone.

5. If your Shizuku app has its own watchdog, the Watcher section appears. Keep "Also wake Shizuku's watchdog on each retry" on to wake that watchdog too, or turn it off so this app does the whole restart itself. "Wake the watcher now" wakes it once, immediately.

Original Shizuku has no automatic start entry point. If your manager cannot be started by another app, the helper notification opens the Shizuku app so you can tap Start once.
Shizuku is running — the button stays green while the service is alive.
Shizuku is not running — the button is red and the helper keeps retrying until it starts.
